episodes.title: Tucson sexual assault survivor says network did not die with Epstein
episodes.description: Jeffery Epstein, an American financier and convicted sex offender, died in 2019 while in custody at a Manhattan jail. His accomplice, Ghislaine Maxwell, is serving a 20-year prison sentence.  See more: https://www.kgun9.com/news/local-news/tucson-sexual-assault-survivor-says-network-did-not-die-with-epstein
